'''''Legacy of the Force: Exile''''' is the fourth novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It is a paperback by [[Aaron Allston]], published on [[February 27]], [[2007]], although the [[Science Fiction Book Club]] did publish an exclusive hardcover.

According to [[Sue Rostoni]], the last day of ''Exile'' is Day 106 in the series, or day 228 in to year 40 ABY, or [[Great ReSynchronization|75:7:15]]. The audio version was narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The cover features [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].
